name: Glove Dove scene
used: Behind Slippery Dishes (the Glove Dove): the kitchen counter the Dove runs along, the sink the wet dishes pop out of on the left, and the plate rack they are flicked into on the right.
standin: A tiled wall, a window, a counter, a sink of suds and a wire plate rack drawn in code, from the side.
prompt: {STYLE} {SCENE}An old-fashioned kitchen seen straight from the side, like a stage. A long wooden counter top runs right across the picture at about 81% of the height, with plain cupboard doors below it to the bottom edge. On the left, from 2% to 21% of the width, a deep white ceramic sink set into the counter, heaped with soap suds (its rim at about 65% of the height), with an old curved chrome tap above it. On the right, from 77% to 97% of the width, an empty wire plate rack standing on a drip tray on the counter, its thin upright wires rising to about 66% of the height, ready for plates. Behind, a pale tiled wall with a small window showing grey rain at the top middle. The counter between the sink and the rack, and all the air above it, are where the game plays (the bird runs along the counter and flicks dishes up through the air into the rack), so keep the wall there plain and quiet, and nothing at all on the counter: no dishes, cloths, bottles or jars anywhere.

name: Dishes from the side
used: Slippery Dishes: the wet dishes flying through the air (the game spins them) and standing in the rack.
standin: Plates, a bowl, a cup and pans drawn in code from the side.
prompt: {STYLE} {SHEET} A 3 x 2 grid of six clean, wet, shiny dishes, each centred in its own 1024 x 1024 cell, all seen from the side at eye level (a plate shows as a flat, slightly tilted ellipse), each about 70% of the cell wide, with a few drops of water and a soap bubble or two on them: 1) a white dinner plate with a slate-blue band round its rim; 2) a cream soup bowl with a mustard rim; 3) a tea cup with a mauve rim and its handle on the right; 4) a steel saucepan with its straight handle out to the right; 5) a black iron frying pan with its long handle out to the right; 6) a glazed ochre pie dish with a fluted rim.

name: Glove Dove cheering and dismayed
used: Slippery Dishes: the Glove Dove cheering when a dish lands in the rack, and dismayed when one smashes.
standin: The portrait hopping, or squashed down.
prompt: {STYLE} {VARIANT} The Glove Dove (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoai2k/mini/main/icecreamcone/game/assets/subjects/glovedove.png ): its head and long neck are one long pink rubber washing-up glove held level, the glove's fingers splayed back as a crest on top of a dove's head with a round yellow eye and a long open pink beak at the front, the glove's long studded cuff stretching straight back behind the head to a ruffled open cuff end, on a round body of scalloped blue-grey feathers, with long ochre scaly legs and dark claws, in two poses side by side, each in its own half and at the same scale, facing left, feet at the bottom: left, cheering: the long glove neck swung up at a jaunty angle with the cuff end high, the finger crest fanned wide, beak open, one foot lifted in a little jump; right, dismayed: the long glove neck drooping down at the cuff end, the finger crest curled in, the head lowered and the eye wide, as if it has just dropped a plate. {ALPHA}

name: Glove Dove catching and flicking
used: Slippery Dishes: the Glove Dove bracing to catch a falling dish on top of its long glove neck, and flicking it up into the air (the game draws the dish).
standin: The portrait braced, then tipped back, with little pink marks over the glove while a catch is ready.
prompt: {STYLE} {VARIANT} The Glove Dove (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoai2k/mini/main/icecreamcone/game/assets/subjects/glovedove.png ): its head and long neck are one long pink rubber washing-up glove held level, the glove's fingers splayed back as a crest on top of a dove's head with a round yellow eye and a long open pink beak at the front, the glove's long studded cuff stretching straight back behind the head to a ruffled open cuff end, on a round body of scalloped blue-grey feathers, with long ochre scaly legs and dark claws, in two poses side by side, each in its own half and at the same scale, facing left, feet at the bottom: left, ready to catch, crouched a little with knees bent, the long glove neck held dead level and steady like a tray, the head tipped to look up with the eye on the sky; right, flicking, sprung up on tiptoe, the long glove neck snapping upward from the shoulders so the cuff end points up at an angle, a few soap drops flying off it. No dish (the game draws it). {ALPHA}
